findings.note: Spec claim contradicted by the implementation it describes. docs/specs/2026-08-27-metareview-0.8.3-sharded-review-results.md §5.1 states that the pack's contract text "is generated from those constants, not hand-copied" (referring to reviewmanifest.EvidenceNoteMinLength and the closed severity/disposition vocabularies). In shardpack.go the contract is two hand-written string literals (shardContractBody, crossShardContractBody) that spell out "at least 12 characters" and the disposition list verbatim. They are correct today, but a change to EvidenceNoteMinLength or to the disposition set would silently desynchronise the instructions the reviewer follows from the rules the validator applies - the same failure mode as the contract bug this round fixed. Spec and code are in different shards (1f and 03-2).

evidence.note: crossShardContractBody/shardContractBody hard-code "at least 12 characters" and the disposition vocabulary as literal text.
EvidenceNoteMinLength = 12 and the disposition constants are the real source of truth the validator uses.
